_comment: Machine-readable role routing matrix. Uses tier labels, not specific model IDs, to avoid hardcoding volatile names. See .harness/docs/research/model-selection.md for full rationale.

fast.description: Small/fast model optimized for speed and low cost. Good for structured output and simple instruction-following.

balanced.description: Mid-tier model balancing quality and cost. Good code generation and instruction following.

reasoning.description: Frontier model with extended thinking. Higher cost, best adversarial resistance and complex decomposition.

user_controlled.description: The user's IDE session model. Not configurable via frontmatter — builder is the main agent, not a subagent.

planner.routing_details: Static balanced default. For architectural/vague tasks (3+ files), a reasoning tier improves decomposition quality. For simple tasks, harness-gate.sh bypass path avoids the planner entirely.
planner.subagent_rationale: Context hygiene: clean context prevents anchoring to builder's prior implementation attempts. A skill would inherit the builder's contaminated context in mid-session restart scenarios.

builder.routing_details: Builder model is the user's IDE chat session model. Not settable via frontmatter — builder is the main agent. Harness compliance improves with stronger models but is driven primarily by rule-following, not model tier.
builder.subagent_rationale: Builder is the main agent. No subagent frontmatter applies. Programmatic routing (SDK Agent.create with explicit model=) is feat-13b territory.

evaluator.routing_details: No signal-based routing — evaluator is always adversarial. Static reasoning tier override recommended. Cost bounded: evaluator runs once per build task, not per turn.
evaluator.subagent_rationale: Structural conflict-of-interest justification (Phase 5 §5.3): model that proposes acceptance criteria cannot objectively judge whether they are met. Separate context also isolates evaluator from builder's reasoning history. Independent of model capability tier.
